name: Get sending health
description: Call this when you need the account-level sending health verdict before creating or sending an email campaign, so you can warn the user that deliverability or reputation checks may block or degrade a send. It reports a single account-wide verdict and whether the account is new; it says nothing about any individual campaign, so use the campaign validation action instead to check a specific campaign's readiness, and use the account action instead for plan, credit, or identity details.
preconditions: The session must be authenticated against the email campaigns backend for an existing Brevo account.

verdict.description: The account's sending health assessment. Only the value "none" has been observed, returned for a brand-new account with no sending history; other values exist but are not evidenced here.

newAccount.description: True when the account is new, meaning there is not enough sending history to produce a health assessment.
